title: MiniMax Sparse Attention

We introduce MiniMax Sparse Attention (MSA), a blockwise sparse attention built upon Grouped Query Attention (GQA). A lightweight Index Branch scores key-value blocks and inde…

title: APPO: Agentic Procedural Policy Optimization

title: OmniDirector: General Multi-Shot Camera Cloning without Cross-Paired Data
summary: Cloning camera motion from reference videos is an important task in video generation, as videos provide intuitive and precise control. Existing methods either directly use parametric representations that fail to handle multi-shot generation or synthesize cross-paired data, which suffer from data scarcity, resulting in poor performance in complicated camera motion cloning. To address these issues, we introduce a general camera motion representation that encodes cameras as grid motion videos. This…
description: camera motion cloning, camera grid, multimodal diffusion transformers, hierarchical prompt expansion agent, video generation
developer_name: Jiwen Liu, Shujuan Li, Zhixue Fang, Xiaohan Li, Yan Zhou et al. (11 authors)

analysis.detail_brief: Cloning camera motion from reference videos is an important task in video generation, as videos provide intuitive and precise control. Existing methods either directly use parametric representations that fail to handle multi-shot generation or synthesize cross-paired data, which suffer from data scarcity, resulting in poor performance in complicated camera motion cloning. To address these issues, we introduce a general camera motion representation that encodes cameras as grid motion videos.

title: Memory is Reconstructed, Not Retrieved: Graph Memory for LLM Agents

To bridge this gap, we propose MRAgent, a framework that combines an associative memory graph with an active reconstruction mechanism. We represent memory as a Cue-Tag-Content grap…

While current memory-augmented agents rely on a static retrieve-then-reason paradigm, this rigid pipeline design prevents them from dynamically adapting memory access to intermediate evidence discovered during inference. title: VIA-SD: Verification via Intra-Model Routing for Speculative Decoding
summary: Speculative decoding (SD) addresses the high inference costs of LLMs by having lightweight drafters generate candidates for large verifiers to validate in parallel. Existing draft-verify methods use binary decisions: accept or fully recompute. Yet we find that many rejected tokens can be verified correctly by a slim submodel derived from the full verifier via intra-model routing, instead of the full verifier. This motivates our slim-verifier to handle tokens requiring moderate verification resou…

title: From 2D Grids to 1D Tokens: Reforming Shared Representations for Multimodal Image Fusion

summary_cn: From 2D Grids to 1D Tokens: Reforming Shared Representations：多模态图像融合旨在将来自不同模态的互补信息集成到融合图像中，从而保留丰富的局部细节，同时保持全局一致的外观。现有方法在 2D 特征网格上构建共享表示，该方法擅长对局部结构进行建模，但对图像级全局外观因素的影响有限。
